name: Lucy
first: First mission to the Jupiter Trojans; visits 8 asteroids in a single 12-year trajectory — more bodies in one mission than any prior planetary science campaign
description: Lucy reaches for the L4 and L5 Lagrange clouds — populations of primordial asteroids leading and trailing Jupiter by 60°, believed to preserve material from the outer protoplanetary disc. Three Earth gravity assists (2022, 2024, 2030) shape a single trajectory that visits seven Trojan asteroids plus a bonus main-belt body. Bonus encounter: Donaldjohanson 2025-04. L4 swarm: Eurybates + moon Queta (2027-08), Polymele (2027-09), Leucus (2028-04), Orus (2028-11). After EGA-3 (2030-12), the trailing L5 swarm: Patroclus-Menoetius binary (2033-03) — the largest Trojan binary known, a fitting climax for the mission's namesake (Lucy the hominid fossil; Patroclus-Menoetius the two characters that fell together in the Iliad).
